verdict.what_is_wrong: Java PID 52884 in one container suffered severe runnable CPU starvation during a roughly two-minute interval: it ran at about 0.20 cores while accumulating 7–8 runnable-wait thread-seconds and hundreds of waits over 50 ms per 10 seconds. Its CPU use and scheduling returned to normal afterward; this strongly suggests a per-container CPU cap, though the trace does not record the quota, and the decisive per-period ceiling and CPU-idle-while-waiting checks were not run, so throttling is inferred rather than proven.
